Pursuant to Article 9 Section 2 Paragraph 1 of the Constitution of the State of Georgia, the Commissioners of Treutlen County, Georgia, hereby create the Treutlen County, Georgia, Historical Department.

Il.

The Trevtlen County, Georgia, Historical Department shall be charged with receiving, collecting, housing, preserving, promoting, and exhibiting data, objects, archives, records, documents, artifacts, pictures, and other matters of general historical interest.

Il.

The "Historical Department" shall consist of a HISTORIAN who shall be appointed by the Board of Commissioners, and who shall serve at the pleasure of the Board of Commissioners. The salary and compensation of the HISTORIAN shall be set by the Board of Commissioners.
3: In addition to all other duties of the Historical Department, the Historical Department shall assist the Probate Judge of Treutlen County, Georgia, in carrying out the requirements and responsibilities of O.C.G.A. 36-16-1 et. seq., in the event said code and chapter are adopted as provided by law.
4:
Effective Date; Repealer: a

Upon adoption of this article and the signing thereof by the Commissioners same shall become effective, and all ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict are hereby repealed.
